assets.name: moon-cat
assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE elegant artistic decorative illustration for a quiet black/white desktop application. The attached image is ONLY an ink-style and monochrome mood reference, not a scene to copy. This ornament is ARTISTIC rather than technical or professional: no detective tools, workstation, charts, files with labels, magnifier, settings gears, icons, logos or UI. Refined black ink and cool gray wash, expressive variable line weights, gently broken contours, a few carefully placed dark shapes, lots of transparent negative space. No full human body or character portrait. Genuinely transparent RGBA background; normal artwork opacity (the application will apply 0.3 opacity). No border, badge, opaque background, lettering, signature, readable writing or watermark text. Keep a small transparent margin and produce a single isolated composition.
A small black cat curled peacefully asleep against the lower curve of a thin crescent moon. The cat's tail follows one graceful loose ink curve, with two tiny scattered star sparks and a single wispy ribbon of gray wash. Almost-square asymmetric composition, approximately 1.15:1. Poetic, restful and understated, like a delicate book illustration; keep the moon open and airy, not a giant solid black circle. The moon and cat should form a naturally connected silhouette.

Three light paper butterflies drift along an expressive sweeping ink ribbon: one angular folded-paper butterfly, one delicate open-wing ink butterfly, and one small distant butterfly. Their wings are mostly white with precise dark edges and a few soft cool gray brush marks. Very wide shallow composition about 2.6:1, airy and asymmetrical, like a poetic margin drawing. One loose ribbon stroke traces their movement; no rectangular pages, business document, professional symbols or realistic anatomy. Leave plenty of transparent space between the forms.
